initialization: Call the WASI reactor _initialize export exactly once before the ABI.
scalar_type: u32 carried by WebAssembly i32; only release results are signed i32
zero: Invalid offset/handle; producer zero means no owned result could be published or the instance is busy.
numeric_namespace: Independent WASI ABI: no native C numeric status, operation, token, record or function-table aliases. Binding error JSON retains its separately versioned core code/code_name vocabulary.

descriptor.ownership: One stable result-owned Box contains descriptor and payload until result_free; host access is read-only. No segment is NUL-terminated.

exports.name: merman_wasi_abi_version
exports.semantics: ABI version 1; zero during same-instance reentry.

exports.name: merman_wasi_alloc
exports.semantics: Zero-initialized live input allocation offset; zero for zero length, exhausted count/byte/address/allocation budget or busy.

exports.name: merman_wasi_free
exports.semantics: Release by exact live input base; returns ok, invalid-allocation or busy.

exports.name: merman_wasi_engine_new
exports.semantics: Owned result handle, never an engine handle. Publish the engine and constructor success result atomically; failures publish no engine.

exports.name: merman_wasi_engine_close
exports.semantics: Retire the live engine; do not invalidate retained results. Returns ok, invalid-handle or busy.

exports.name: merman_wasi_execute
exports.semantics: Owned operation or metadata result handle. Dispatch shared BindingOperationRequest/BindingEngine or BindingEngine::metadata_json, not a new business parser.

exports.name: merman_wasi_runtime_catalog
exports.semantics: Owned shared runtime catalog result; transport_api_version is independently 1.

exports.name: merman_wasi_result_info
exports.semantics: Stable descriptor offset; zero for unknown/freed/wrong-kind handle or busy.

exports.name: merman_wasi_result_free
exports.semantics: Release descriptor and all owned payload bytes; returns ok, invalid-handle or busy.

config.encoding: UTF-8 JSON; reject unknown fields and duplicate envelope fields

optional_fields.options: RawValue forwarded unchanged to bindings-core; absent/null/empty object selects resources.profile interactive.
optional_fields.fonts: Array of objects with required u32 offset and length, no unknown fields; ranges are nonempty and relative to the separately supplied raw font blob. Defaults to an empty array.
optional_fields.bundled_fonts: Boolean; defaults to whether bundled-fonts is compiled. Requesting an unavailable bundle returns an owned missing-capability error.

config.font_service: Only NativeFontContext::from_font_bytes with bounded NativeFontLimits and strict glyph coverage. Caller fonts precede bundled fonts; inputs are copied before successful publication. No font discovery or SVG font embedding. Without native-fonts construction returns missing-capability.

request.encoding: UTF-8 JSON; reject unknown fields and duplicate envelope fields

optional_fields.options: RawValue forwarded unchanged to core. Absent/null/empty object inherits the engine profile; preserve an explicit constrained profile and its math rejection.
optional_fields.uri: UTF-8 string used by shared document-analysis operations.

request.operation_id: Shared core operation ID, or a metadata_ids entry advertised by runtime_catalog. Named metadata requires empty source and no URI or nonempty option overlay.
request.source: Separate raw byte range; never base64. Transport does not parse Mermaid or SVG.

operation_success.json: Unchanged core BindingOperationMetadata; additive svg_viewport is CSS px, raster output_plan carries pixel size.

error.json: binding_error_payload_json_bytes: version, ok=false, code, code_name, kind, capability_id, message, optional details; preserve core byte spans.

limits.additional_limits: Shared NativeFontLimits bound font counts/faces, measurement and caches; core resource profiles bound operation work. Transport budgets do not bound every transient allocation or the entire heap. Host must bound linear memory and execution.

lifecycle: Each nonempty input is a checked contained range of one live allocation from this instance; no arbitrary pointer conversion or result-as-input. Canonical empty range is (0,0); nonzero empty offsets must still belong to live inputs.

Inputs are borrowed only during the synchronous call. Font bytes are copied at construction. Free takes only exact allocation bases. Released input addresses may later be reused; input offsets are not durable identities.
Engine/result handles share a monotonically increasing nonzero u32 namespace and are never reused; separate live registries reject wrong-kind handles.

Result descriptor and payload remain stable until result_free, independently of input free, later calls and engine close. Host must copy retained output before result_free and must not free it with a host allocator.
Only deterministic runtime policy and the native-font-context constructor are admitted; no callbacks, icon service or native C function table.
Same-instance operations are serial and nonblocking; reject reentry. Hosts must not write module memory concurrently or mutate read-only result/private storage.
Ordinary core errors return owned JSON and allow subsequent calls. A budget/allocation failure returns an owned error if that result fits, otherwise zero.
Use try_reserve where available, but do not promise panic, allocator OOM or trap recovery. Discard the complete instance after any trap.
